note: Round stone wall openings (docs/50), art round 9. offset: the PNG's top-left in screen px from the ring's centre on the ground (the centre tile's centre, iso.toScreen(cx, cy)); anchor_px is the same point inside the PNG. depth_plane: two ground points in tiles from the ring's centre, for depth.planeThrough(cx + x0, cy + y0, cx + x1, cy + y1). layer: the order within the half's drawable when two pieces tie (reveal 0, leaf 1, open leaf 2, frame 3, open shutters 4, boards 5). Points: n 270, e 0, s 90, w 180 degrees (rings.js DOOR_ANGLES); e and s on the near half (outer face seen), n and w on the far half (inner face seen).
